searchText: Hello Vid. I had a similar problem on debugging while I was developing. I created an integration test to test locally. I used anvil(like hard hat node) to start a test node. The node also supports debug_trace. I create some integration funtion like compile the abstract account solidity codes and deploy the codes to the local test node . I hope this could help you. https://github.com/Vid201/aa-bundler/pull/26/commits/87e292e2d1d82b645e3df9cdd497ba024a916347 Dev updates week 8 | 19.12.-26.12. That's also good for initial testing; I'll look into it. Tnx! Hey everyone, is anyone here comfortable with Vite? I am trying to polyfill Node.js built-in modules, reference: https://medium.com/@ftaioli/using-node-js-builtin-modules-with-vite-6194737c2cd2 And I am running into this problem: https://pastebin.com/GWRFqWVr My Vite config file: https://gist.github.com/plusminushalf/33d3d8a45b2924c846348f3f0ace17d5 Standup call in 30 min folks 🙂 https://meet.ethereum.org/epf-standup <@&857649635274915900> starting now
